from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class QuarterlyAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """Total asset disclosure from one quarter's financial report."""
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period (e.g., '2021年3月31日')")
    quarter: str | None = Field(description="Which quarter in the series (e.g., '2021 Q1')")
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name this report belongs to")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total assets amount as reported in the document")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the amount, e.g., '元'")
    year_over_year_change: str | None = Field(description="Any stated year-over-year or YoY change percentage from the report")
    compare_to: str | None = Field(description="What the reported figure is compared against, e.g., '2020年末'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    quarterly_asset_records: list[QuarterlyAssetRecord]
